notes.subject: k'an ɲɛ
notes.rationale: זכר: weleli Yawe fɛ ('k'a ɲɛ') walima kelen-kelen b'a jira-ko ye ('n b'a ɲɛsuna') — LXX ani JPS bɛ weleli fɛ.

notes.subject: da-ɲɔɔgɔn
notes.rationale: לענה ye jiri-dɔ min bɛ nnɔgɔ dɔgɔ kosɛbɛ; Bamanankan tɛ daɲɛ kelen sɔrɔ, o la da-ɲɔgɔn (nnɔgɔ da) tɛmɛ.

notes.subject: וראש
notes.rationale: ראש (dɔgɔ-jiri) dee sɛbɛn o sɛbɛn cogo dɔrɔn de ye Tanaki kɔnɔ Debirime (Deuteronomy) 29:17; 'kun' (7218) tɛ o ye.

translation: K'an ɲɛ: n basiya ani n yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma, da-ɲɔgɔnw ni dɔgɔ.
